jobs.title: Mechatronic Design & Test Engineer
jobs.description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Wingtra builds professional drones that help people map and understand the world. Join the team creating our next aircraft and the tools that build and test it. You’ll be a hands-on generalist who combines mechatronic design and system integration. You’ll work for drone operators and for our colleagues on the production floor. We’re early adopters of AI and build agents into everyday engineering. We want you to keep expanding what we can design, build and test. Responsibilities Design what flies and what attaches to it. You design, integrate and qualify mechanical and mechatronic assemblies for the drone and its accessories. That covers mounts and interfaces, plus sensors and actuators working together. You team up with our electronics designers and suppliers to get designs that can be manufactured. Build the rigs that prove it. You develop qualification rigs and production QC setups. You design fixtures and adapters in CAD, integrate PCBAs and instruments and wire sensors and actuators. Then you bring up the whole system, debug and iterate it until it’s reliable. Automate the checks. You integrate a Raspberry Pi and write Python tools for flashing, calibration and end-of-line checks. You build the operator interface with serial-number traceability and robust data pipeline. Make every test mean something. You design for testability. You use requirements and FMEA to define tests and to justify pass/fail limits. You validate measurement accuracy and repeatability, diagnose faults and improve production yield. Take it to the line. You commission QC stations with the Production Engineers on shared infrastructure. You support their takeover and resolve issues through ramp-up. You leave behind tools and documentation they can maintain. Requirements You have depth in one engineering discipline. You’ve also integrated mechanics, electronics and software into systems that work. We value complementary strengths and practical ownership across disciplines. You enjoy product design and test engineering alike. Building tools that make your colleagues on the production floor faster and happier is part of the fun. AI agents already help you learn, design, code and analyze. You check what they produce, invent better workflows and share what works with the team. You prototype fast, debug systematically and keep going until something is reliable enough for someone else to use. You’ll sit in the Engineering team with real ownership, from the first concept to a working production line. You’re based in Zurich. During commissioning and ramp-up, you’ll spend time with our production partners in Europe and the USA. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. jobs.cover_note:
I am applying for the Mechatronic Design & Test Engineer position at Wingtra.

With over 13 years of experience in quality assurance, I bring a structured approach to system testing, integration testing, and root cause analysis. Throughout my career, including my current role at MetaDesign Solutions, I have focused on test planning, test case design, and defect lifecycle management across complex technical environments. I specialize in establishing end-to-end testing strategies, validating integration points, and leveraging automated test execution to verify performance and functional behavior. My background in requirement analysis, risk analysis, and QA process improvement enables me to bring testing rigor and reliability verification to Wingtra's qualification workflows.

jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: About us: Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive. The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals. Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market. As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies. About the Role The AI Automation Engineer will work across different areas of the company to identify opportunities where AI and automation can improve processes, reduce manual work, and support more scalable operations. This is a hands-on role combining technical implementation, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration. You will help take automation initiatives from initial idea and requirements through implementation, testing, documentation, and ongoing improvement. You will also help ensure that AI-powered workflows are implemented responsibly, with appropriate human oversight, controls, documentation, and monitoring—particularly when working with sensitive, financial, or customer-related processes. What You'll Do Design, build, implement, and maintain AI-powered automations and agentic workflows across different business functions. Partner with teams across the organization to understand existing processes, identify automation opportunities, and translate business needs into practical technical solutions. Support AI automation projects from scoping and design through testing, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Integrate AI tools and agents with existing systems, data sources, APIs, and business workflows. Implement appropriate human-in-the-loop controls, monitoring, logging, and audit trails within automated processes. Troubleshoot and improve existing automations to enhance reliability, performance, and scalability. Maintain clear technical and process documentation for implemented solutions. Collaborate with Compliance, Product, Technology, Operations, and other teams to ensure solutions align with business, security, and regulatory requirements. Stay current with developments in AI agents, automation frameworks, and related technologies, and evaluate their potential application within Airtm. What We're Looking For Experience building or implementing AI-powered automations, AI agents, or agentic workflows. Experience with automation platforms, APIs, integrations, or workflow orchestration tools. Experience with Claude, OpenClaw, or similar AI and agent development tools. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate business processes into practical technical solutions. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Understanding of responsible AI practices, including human oversight, access controls, monitoring, and documentation. Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage projects and priorities across different teams. Professional fluency in English. Experience in fintech, financial services, or another regulated environment is valued, but we also welcome candidates with relevant AI and automation experience from other industries. Nice to Have Familiarity with AML, KYC, fraud prevention, compliance, or other financial-services processes. Experience working with SQL, data tools, APIs, or Google Workspace. Experience implementing AI or automation solutions in regulated or control-focused environments. Familiarity with AI governance, auditability, monitoring, or model and automation controls. jobs.title: Marketing Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Growth at Private Equity Insights Are you excited about solving real, hard problems? Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights. The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. You will learn to write copy that makes elite investors act, map the entire market of investors, decide who to target, and deploy AI to outperform a teams of 20+ people. If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career, apply. Why Private Equity Insights Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more. Private Equity Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1. What we offer you Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way Unlimited growth potential. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts. Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale. Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act. Travel opportunity. You will be joining our conferences Your Responsibilities Your responsibilities will vary; however, some of them will be to: Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many. Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI. Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move. Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last. Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value to the client. What we expect from you You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you’re humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you: 1 to 3 years of experience Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas. Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise Practical details Role is full-time, in person from our London
